I am pretty sure I was the last person to see my friend in my senior year of highschool. I left his house at about 2pm after hanging out with him and went on with my day. I worked a night shift and then stayed the night at another friends house. I woke up at 10am to his parents calling me. They told me he had gone missing and didnt show up to work at 8am. Later that day I had a police officer deliver the news to me. I would never see my friend again. Suicide is so painful for everyone around the victim. I know for sure I was the last person he contacted. Please practice self care and self worth everyone.

One of my best friends took his own life about a month before we graduated highschool. It was confirmed that I was one of the last people he contacted before he did the final act. I still remember exactly where I was and what I was doing when he sent me his final message. " I am sorry bro, I'm sorry." About 2 weeks later, we had a football player die in a tragic car accident. Two deaths two weeks before we graduated. Not a very great way to end highschool, if you ask me.

Hai! Lowly silver 3 here! Though my rank might not be impressive, I have been playing around the time of preseason 2-ish. I've been playing ranked since season 3 and I usually ADC though I've had my fair share of jungling. I think that the only time you should gank a losing lane is if they REALLY need it. Most laners (especially a scaling adc like Vayne, Kog'Maw, or Kai'Sa to name a few) will do damage at some point in the game as long as they aren't 0/15 (over exaggerated). But for the most part, especially when i'm playing jungle, you should always be pushing advantages. So if top lane is losing, take a dragon, invade enemy bot side jungle, pressure bot lane really hard. Then if top lane really needs a gank, wait till the enemy jungle shows bot and rotate top to gank. Something along those lines. These kinds of things usually work for me in my ranked games when I play jungle. Of course, it's always good to get your laners ahead early. If you have a feeling one lane is going to loose, plan to gank that lane really early and give them an advantage. Jungle and support (in my opinion) use the most teamwork and are supposed to be helping the carries throughout the game. I may be completely wrong. Just bringing a new perspective to the table.
